sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: In this ordinance, "kiosk operator" means a person who holds a licence to run a self-service book kiosk in the Village of Fenwick Hollow.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: The purpose of this ordinance is to set fair rules for self-service book kiosks so that residents may borrow books close to home.

sections.heading: Operator duties
sections.text:
(a) Except as provided in Sec. 5, a kiosk operator shall keep the kiosk stocked with at least fifty books.
(b) A kiosk operator shall report a damaged kiosk to the Library Board within five (5) calendar days after the damage is found.
(c) A kiosk operator may not charge a fee for borrowing a book.

sections.heading: Library Board duties
sections.text:
(a) Except as provided in Sec. 6, the Library Board shall inspect each kiosk on or before December 1, 2026.
(b) The Library Board shall publish a list of kiosk locations on the Village website.

sections.heading: School kiosks
sections.text: A kiosk placed inside a school building is exempt from the stocking rule.

sections.heading: Inspection exemptions
sections.text: (a) A kiosk run by a school is exempt from inspection fees.

sections.heading: Short title
sections.text: This ordinance may be cited as the Fenwick Hollow Book Kiosk Ordinance.

amendments.instructionText: In Sec. 6, after subsection (a) insert a new subsection (b): "The Library Board need not inspect a kiosk that is housed inside the Village Hall."

operations.text: (b) The Library Board need not inspect a kiosk that is housed inside the Village Hall.
